lines.text: Chapter 8: Below Stairs. The office. A leaflet on the desk has a cartoon knight on it.
Castle Ambry. Daily tours, a gift shop, jousting on Sundays.
The tour used to go down one flight of stairs. Yesterday it went down nine. They have lost a school trip's packed lunches and a man called Dennis.
He plays Sir Dennis, in the jousting. He went down on Tuesday to look for the lunches.
I hope somebody told him the lunches are not worth it.
